notes: Self-contained four-stroke spark-ignition engine explainer with crank-angle-driven cutaway motion, valve timing, pressure and gas-torque readouts, timeline controls, and ignition/compression/speed what-if controls. Geometry uses an 86 mm bore and stroke with a 143 mm connecting rod. Cylinder pressure is an explicitly idealised polytropic/combustion approximation, not a validated combustion or engine simulation; torque is the instantaneous gas-pressure contribution from slider-crank virtual work and excludes inertia, friction, pumping and load. External Google Fonts are optional; system sans/monospace fallbacks are provided. Headless Chromium was available but stalled during a cold file:// launch, so browser interaction and console verification could not be completed; JavaScript syntax, HTML parsing, and metadata were checked statically.
